## What this issue is about
This issue focuses on improving the spellcheck functionality in the Volto project. It involves ensuring consistent spelling for terms like "JavaScript" and "NodeJS" to maintain clarity and professionalism in the documentation.

## What needs to be done
- Update the `accept.txt` and `reject.txt` files in `styles/Vocab/Plone/` to include the preferred spellings and remove incorrect ones.
- Be careful not to disrupt any coding syntax that may use these terms.

## Helpful background
The project uses Vale for spellchecking. Refer to [Vale documentation](https://vale.sh/docs/topics/vocab/) for detailed guidance on how to manage vocabulary files. Check the [Plone contribution documentation](https://6.docs.plone.org/contributing/documentation/setup-build.html#vale) for setup instructions.

## Good first steps
1. Familiarize yourself with the current contents of the `accept.txt` and `reject.txt` files.
2. Start with a small number of changes to avoid overwhelming reviews. Incremental changes are easier to manage than large pull requests.
3. If you're new to the process, take a look at the general [contributing guide](https://6.docs.plone.org/contributing/index.html).
4. Don’t hesitate to ask questions in the comments if you need clarification!
